title: Z-bracket bent from sheet

description.en: A Z-shaped bracket as if bent from 2 mm sheet, 25 mm wide. Its profile lies in the XY plane (Y up) and is extruded along +Z from Z = 0: a bottom flange lying on the X axis, from X = 0, with 30 mm of flat before the first bend; a 90 degree bend upwards with a 2 mm inside radius; an upright web with 36 mm of flat; a 90 degree bend back to +X with the same inside radius; a top flange with 20 mm of flat. Each flange has a 5 mm hole through it, centred on its flat and on the width. Drive it by the variables flange_a, web, flange_c, bend_r, thickness, width and hole_d.
description.nl: Een Z-vormige beugel alsof hij uit plaat van 2 mm gezet is, 25 mm breed. Het profiel ligt in het XY-vlak (Y omhoog) en wordt langs +Z geëxtrudeerd vanaf Z = 0: een onderflens op de X-as, vanaf X = 0, met 30 mm vlak deel voor de eerste zetting; een zetting van 90 graden naar boven met een binnenstraal van 2 mm; een staand lijf met 36 mm vlak deel; een zetting van 90 graden terug naar +X met dezelfde binnenstraal; een bovenflens met 20 mm vlak deel. Elke flens heeft een gat van 5 mm erdoor, in het midden van zijn vlakke deel en van de breedte. Stuur hem met de variabelen flange_a, web, flange_c, bend_r, thickness, width en hole_d.

variables.name: flange_a
variables.meaning: flat length of the bottom flange

variables.name: flange_c
variables.meaning: flat length of the top flange

expect.value: (thickness * (flange_a + web + flange_c) + 2 * (pi / 4 * ((bend_r + thickness)^2 - bend_r^2))) * width - 2 * (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness)

2 * (thickness * (flange_a + web + flange_c) + 2 * (pi / 4 * ((bend_r + thickness)^2 - bend_r^2))) + (2 * (flange_a + web + flange_c) + 2 * thickness + pi * (2 * bend_r + thickness)) * width + 2 * (pi * hole_d * thickness - 2 * pi / 4 * hole_d^2)

value: (width * (flange_a * thickness * flange_a / 2 + thickness * web * (flange_a + bend_r + thickness / 2) + flange_c * thickness * (flange_a + 2 * bend_r + thickness + flange_c / 2) + (pi / 4 * ((bend_r + thickness)^2 - bend_r^2)) * (flange_a + (4 / (3 * pi) * ((bend_r + thickness)^3 - bend_r^3) / ((bend_r + thickness)^2 - bend_r^2))) + (pi / 4 * ((bend_r + thickness)^2 - bend_r^2)) * (flange_a + 2 * bend_r + thickness - (4 / (3 * pi) * ((bend_r + thickness)^3 - bend_r^3) / ((bend_r + thickness)^2 - bend_r^2)))) - (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness) * flange_a / 2 - (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness) * (flange_a + 2 * bend_r + thickness + flange_c / 2)) / ((thickness * (flange_a + web + flange_c) + 2 * (pi / 4 * ((bend_r + thickness)^2 - bend_r^2))) * width - 2 * (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness))

(width * (flange_a * thickness * thickness / 2 + thickness * web * (bend_r + thickness + web / 2) + flange_c * thickness * (bend_r + thickness + web + bend_r + thickness / 2) + (pi / 4 * ((bend_r + thickness)^2 - bend_r^2)) * (bend_r + thickness - (4 / (3 * pi) * ((bend_r + thickness)^3 - bend_r^3) / ((bend_r + thickness)^2 - bend_r^2))) + (pi / 4 * ((bend_r + thickness)^2 - bend_r^2)) * (bend_r + thickness + web + (4 / (3 * pi) * ((bend_r + thickness)^3 - bend_r^3) / ((bend_r + thickness)^2 - bend_r^2)))) - (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness) * thickness / 2 - (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness) * (bend_r + thickness + web + bend_r + thickness / 2)) / ((thickness * (flange_a + web + flange_c) + 2 * (pi / 4 * ((bend_r + thickness)^2 - bend_r^2))) * width - 2 * (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness))

derivation: The section is three straight strips of thickness t, lengths a, web and c, and two quarter rings of inner radius r and outer r + t, each (pi/4)((r + t)^2 - r^2): A = 2 (30 + 36 + 20) + 2 * 9.42 = 190.85 mm^2. V = A w less two holes pi d^2/4 t.

Perimeter: both sides of each strip, 2 (a + web + c), the two ends 2 t, and the bends' arcs, (pi/2)(r + (r + t)) each: pi (2 r + t). Area = 2 A + perimeter * w; each hole swaps two discs for its wall.

Centroid: a quarter ring's centroid lies 4 / (3 pi) ((r + t)^3 - r^3) / ((r + t)^2 - r^2) from its centre along each of its two edges' directions; the first bend's centre is (a, r + t), the second's (a + 2r + t, r + t + web). The strips' centroids are their middles; the holes sit in the middles of the flanges. Z = w/2.
